info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Elemental MediaConvert API (2017-08-29). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Queues, job templates, presets and the account policy are stored records: no transcoding job, endpoint, certificate or resource share exists, and no input is read from or output written to Amazon S3, HTTP or HTTPS. CreateJob, GetJob, ListJobs, SearchJobs, CancelJob, StartJobsQuery, GetJobsQueryResults, DescribeEndpoints, Probe, AssociateCertificate, DisassociateCertificate, CreateResourceShare and ListVersions return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Queues are ON_DEMAND, CUSTOM and ACTIVE or PAUSED with zero submitted and progressing jobs; PricingPlan RESERVED and ReservationPlanSettings are refused because a reservation is a purchase. The account's Default queue and the system presets and job templates that AWS owns are not served, so a job template Queue must name a queue created here, and the queues named in HopDestinations are stored without being resolved. Every custom queue is limited to 10 per Region and every job template or preset to 100 by the simulator, which are not AWS quotas. The tag operations are not implemented because MediaConvert reads tags only through ListTagsForResource, whose nested ResourceTags output the catalog cannot render: TagResource, UntagResource and ListTagsForResource return HTTP 501, and Tags at creation are refused instead of being stored unreadable. The list members ListBy and Order are refused and listing returns creation order; Category filters job templates and presets. GetPolicy before PutPolicy returns an empty policy instead of the account default, and the stored policy limits no input. PutPolicy replaces only the members it supplies, and DeletePolicy fails with NotFoundException (HTTP 404) when no policy was stored.
